EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Mobile App (WO)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
We understand that you're interested in the process of utilizing mobile devices for your Time & Attendance program. To best accommodate mobile devices, we have the Insperity Mobile App, which is available at both Google Play (Android), and the Apple Store. Search for "Insperity Mobile" and you can download the application for free. Some things you'll need to know about the mobile app are:
You need to be on the most current version of the Time & Attendance software.
Employees need to be set up for web punching if you wish to allow them to punch.
Currently, the mobile app has punching and request capabilities, as well as timesheet approval options, based on the setup of your company. More functionality is in development at this time.
Please let us know if you have any further questions and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
